import json, os, subprocess, sys, uuid
from pathlib import Path
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
root = Path.cwd()
evidence = root / "personal-project-conversion/evidence/phase-3-20260920"
owned = json.loads((evidence / "postgres-ownership.json").read_text())
info = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", owned["container_id"]]))[0]
assert info["Name"] == "/" + owned["container_name"]
assert info["Created"] == owned["created"] and info["Image"] == owned["image"]
assert info["State"]["Running"]
name = "nip_phase3_final_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
url = "postgresql+psycopg2://[synthetic-role]:[redacted]@127.0.0.1:58553/" + name
admin = create_engine("postgresql+psycopg2://[synthetic-role]:[redacted]@127.0.0.1:58553/postgres", isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")
with admin.connect() as connection:
    assert not connection.execute(text("SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname LIKE '\''nip_stage7_%'\''")).all()
    connection.exec_driver_sql('\''CREATE DATABASE "'\'' + name + '\''"'\'')
admin.dispose()
(evidence / "final-suite-database.json").write_text(json.dumps({**owned, "database_name": name, "database_url": url}, indent=2))
env = {**os.environ, "APP_ENV": "test", "REQUIRE_POSTGRES": "1", "POSTGRES_HOST_PORT": "58553", "DATABASE_URL": url, "REQUIRE_DATABASE_ROLE_HARDENING": "1", "POSTGRES_TOOL_CONTAINER": owned["container_id"], "POSTGRES_TOOL_CONTAINER_ADMIN_ROLE": "news", "OPENAI_API_KEY": "", "GEMINI_API_KEY": "", "GOOGLE_API_KEY": "", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": ""}
with (evidence / "full-integration-final.log").open("w") as output:
    migration = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "alembic", "upgrade", "head"], env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert migration.returncode == 0
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests/integration"], env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print(json.dumps({"exit_code": result.returncode, "log": str(evidence / "full-integration-final.log")}), flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
'
